project_name: Thunderhead Energy Jefferson County data center campus
aliases: Thunderhead Energy Solutions Jefferson County AI data center
status_detail: Local reporting says Thunderhead Energy Solutions filed for Clean Air Act exemptions for a 500 MW behind-the-meter solar and natural-gas turbine power facility to support federal government-related AI data processing in Jefferson County. Follow-up reporting said the project was not on the White House/EPA exemption approval list as of late April 2026, so approval appears uncertain and possibly rejected, but more exemptions could still be issued.
notes: No specific site disclosed. The Monitor article says the exemption filing was shared by MEIC and described grid constraints in Jefferson County, MT; MEIC also hosted a Boulder, MT data center impacts panel. Status kept as announced/uncertain rather than rejected because follow-up article only infers likely rejection from absence on an EPA approval list.

notes: Official state announcement provides original announcement, developer/personnel context, capacity, city, and power source.
